title: 418. Largest BST Subtree

examples.explanation: The branch rooted at 5 (nodes 5, 1, 8) is ordered with 3 nodes; the right branch breaks ordering.
The whole tree respects the ordering, so all 3 nodes count.
A single node always forms an ordered subtree of size 1.
